paper.title_en: Charged Black Holes with a Lorentz--Violating Kalb--Ramond Background
paper.abstract_en: We investigate exact static, spherically symmetric electrically charged black hole solutions in a gravitational theory with spontaneous Lorentz-symmetry breaking induced by a background Kalb--Ramond field. In contrast to previous analyses that retained only one nonminimal curvature coupling, we include the combined effects of the two independent nonminimal curvature couplings and obtain charged black hole solutions both with and without a cosmological constant. Using the Iyer--Wald covariant phase-space formalism, we derive the corrected thermodynamic quantities and analyze the Joule--Thomson expansion, including the inversion curve and the cooling/heating regions. We further apply the topological approach to black hole thermodynamics to characterize the van der Waals-like phase transition and show how the thermodynamic critical temperature and pressure are encoded in the corresponding topological defect curve. These results clarify the thermodynamic and topological signatures of electrically charged black holes in gravity with a Lorentz-violating Kalb--Ramond background.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了洛伦兹对称性破缺的Kalb-Ramond背景下的荷电黑洞解，并分析了其热力学性质，包括Joule-Thomson膨胀和拓扑相变，内容详实，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 具有洛伦兹对称性破缺的Kalb-Ramond背景的荷电黑洞
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在由背景Kalb-Ramond场诱导的自发洛伦兹对称性破缺的引力理论中的精确静态、球对称荷电黑洞解。与之前仅保留一个非最小曲率耦合的分析不同，我们包含了两个独立的非最小曲率耦合的综合效应，并获得了有和没有宇宙学常数的荷电黑洞解。使用Iyer-Wald协变相空间形式，我们推导了修正的热力学量，并分析了Joule-Thomson膨胀，包括反演曲线和冷却/加热区域。我们进一步将拓扑方法应用于黑洞热力学，以表征类范德瓦尔斯相变，并展示热力学临界温度和压力如何编码在相应的拓扑缺陷曲线中。这些结果阐明了在具有洛伦兹对称性破缺的Kalb-Ramond背景的引力中荷电黑洞的热力学和拓扑特征。
